last.verdict: PENN's casinos kept growing and its online losses shrank sharply to $18.3 million, with management reaffirming its full-year Interactive profit target.

takeaways.label: Online losses shrinking
takeaways.text: The Interactive (online betting and casino) segment lost $18.3 million, versus $76.6 million a year earlier. Management cited growth in Hollywood iCasino and Canada, and reaffirmed its full-year Interactive target.

takeaways.label: Casinos still growing
takeaways.text: Retail revenue hit a record $1.5 billion with a 33.7% profit margin. Margins have now improved year over year for three quarters in a row. Management said October trends stayed healthy.

takeaways.label: Earnings up, debt down
takeaways.text: Adjusted EBITDA (core operating profit) rose to $284.0 million from $194.9 million. Net debt fell to $1.8 billion, from $2.2 billion at the end of 2025.

takeaways.label: Spending and share count fall
takeaways.text: Capital spending dropped to $59.2 million from $172.7 million as big building projects finished. The average share count fell to 133.9 million from 143.5 million.

history.verdict: Record casino results and a smaller digital loss won modest approval.

reasons.label: Record casino quarter
reasons.text: Retail revenue hit a record $1.5 billion; nine properties set Q2 records, and July trends stayed strong.

reasons.label: Digital losses shrinking
reasons.text: Interactive lost $9.5 million versus $62.0 million a year ago; iCasino revenue hit a record.

reasons.label: Profit jump, debt falling
reasons.text: Adjusted EBITDA rose to $312.6 million from $236.1 million; net debt fell to $1.9 billion.
